proof_body:
by
  intro m v
  have hm : ∀ t : ℝ, MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun x : ℝ => Real.exp (t * (x - m))) (ProbabilityTheory.gaussianReal m v) := by
    intro t
    have h := (ProbabilityTheory.integrable_exp_mul_gaussianReal (μ := m) (v := v) t).const_mul (Real.exp (-(t * m)))
    refine h.congr (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun x => ?_)
    simp only
    rw [← Real.exp_add]; congr 1; ring
  refine ⟨hm, fun t => le_of_eq ?_⟩
  have h2 : ProbabilityTheory.mgf (fun x : ℝ => x - m) (ProbabilityTheory.gaussianReal m v) t = Real.exp (t * (-m)) * ProbabilityTheory.mgf (fun x : ℝ => x) (ProbabilityTheory.gaussianReal m v) t := by
    have := ProbabilityTheory.mgf_const_add (X := fun x : ℝ => x) (μ := ProbabilityTheory.gaussianReal m v) (t := t) (-m)
    rw [← this]
    simp only [sub_eq_neg_add]
  rw [h2, ProbabilityTheory.mgf_fun_id_gaussianReal, ← Real.exp_add]
  congr 1; ring
target_source: ∀ (m : ℝ) (v : NNReal), ProbabilityTheory.HasSubgaussianMGF (fun x : ℝ => x - m) v (ProbabilityTheory.gaussianReal m v)
